full_judgment: Plaintiff respondent No. 3, Dutch Bangla Bank Ltd, Matuail Branch, Jatrabari, Dhaka is the lender institution and Fareast Finance and Investment Ltd. is the borrower company availing of 100 million term credit facility vide sanction letter dated 25-10-2016, Anx H-5. Defendant No. 13 of the Suit, Santanu Saha (pro-forma respondent No. 10) and defendant No.14, Mohammad Hafizour Rahman (pro-forma respondent No. 11) were the then Managing Director and Deputy Managing Director of the lender institution respectively who dealt with the credit transaction executing loan agreement and different charge documents necessary for security of the loan. On 17-12-2020, the lender-Bank served a legal notice upon these defendant petitioners and others to which instant defendant-petitioner No.2, Mohammad Ali Zaryab (present Managing Director of the borrower company), responded and admitting the loan deposited Taka 143,36,405 to liquidate the liability in part. He on 29-12-2020 applied to the lender bank for second rescheduling Annex H-7, of the loan and its first rescheduling was approved on 19-2-2019, Annex H-6, at the instance of the erstwhile Managing Director, Santanu Saha. The bank though agreed to the rescheduling proposal but defendants did not provide all required legal documents to assist the bank. Thereafter, the bank further served legal notice to these defendant-petitioners and others but to no effect. Finally, the bank in order to recover the outstanding liabilities of Taka 6,15, 52, 614. 61 as on 10-5-2022 instituted the above Artha Rin suit No.183 of 2022 against the instant 7 defendant-petitioners and 14 others wherein these defendant-petitioners and defendant nos. 16-20 of the suit submitted an application to strike out their names from defendants' category under Order I, rule 10(2) of the Code of Civil procedure read with section 6(5) and 57 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003. The leaned trial court upon hearing the parties rejected the application vide impugned order No. 24 dated 22-1-2024, Annexure F.
